title: API keys
description: Keys let another system read and write this workshop's data through the API. Each key acts with the role you give it.
createDescription: The key is shown once, when it's created. Store it somewhere safe.
createFailed: The key could not be created.
name: Name
roleHint: The key can do what this role allows, and nothing more.
needRole: Create a role under Settings, Roles first: a key always acts with a role.
ipAllowlistHint: Separate addresses with commas or spaces. Leave empty to allow any address.
shownDescription: Copy it now. You won't be able to see it again.
revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working at once. This can't be undone.
revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked.
ownerOnly: Only an owner or administrator can manage API keys.
